response.rationale: Classic mucocutaneous findings and elevated inflammatory markers meet Kawasaki criteria; MIS-C less specific without shock or cardiac dysfunction.

rejected.why: Negative SARS-CoV-2 PCR and lack of severe systemic features make MIS-C less likely than KD.
No arthritis or evanescent rash; mucocutaneous features point to KD.
Fever and sore throat are nonspecific; no lymphadenopathy or atypical lymphocytosis.
